title: Paper Explain Pipeline — Full paper analysis from arXiv URL to interactive website
description: End-to-end pipeline: fetch TeX sources, gather resources, create flow explanation, review, revise, and generate an interactive website.

tasks.subtask_prompt: Download and analyze TeX sources from the provided archive URL. Run `.venv/bin/python download_tex_source.py <archive_url>` from the repo root. Find all .tex files, create detailed per-file notes in paper_dir/notes/tex/, and write tex_manifest.md. Return the paper_dir path.

Using the paper_dir from the fetch-tex step, webfetch the arXiv abstract page, build a section outline (paper_dir/notes/paper_outline.md), extract and summarize key bibliography sources (paper_dir/notes/bibliography_summary.md), and create a resource index (paper_dir/notes/resource_index.md). Return the outline_path, bibliography_summary_path, and resource_index_path.

Using the paper_dir from fetch-tex, create paper_dir/notes/paper_flow.md with: overview, mindmap diagram, detailed section walkthrough, math details with notation and intuition, algorithms with Mermaid diagrams, and glossary. Save Mermaid sources as .mmd and render PNGs in paper_dir/diagrams/. Return paper_flow_path and diagrams_dir.

Assess paper_dir/notes/paper_flow.md against the main TeX sources in paper_dir. First do a quick quality scan: if the flow is already solid with no significant issues, write a brief review_feedback.md stating 'No revisions needed' and stop. If issues exist, fact-check claims, equations, and diagrams in detail. Write actionable feedback to paper_dir/notes/review_feedback.md with sections: accuracy issues, missing coverage, math/notation corrections, diagram issues, clarity improvements, and an actionable edit list. Include a severity summary. Return review_feedback_path and whether revisions are needed (yes/no).

Check review_feedback.md from the review-flow step. If it says 'No revisions needed' or has only minor cosmetics, make minor corrections and skip full revision. If substantive issues exist, revise paper_flow.md by incorporating all feedback. Add/update a 'Revision Notes' section. Return the updated paper_flow_path and diagrams_dir.

Using paper_dir, paper_flow_path, and diagrams_dir from revise-flow, generate an interactive website in paper_dir/website/. Create HTML pages per section, glossary with tooltips, KaTeX math rendering, responsive CSS, navigation, and a local serve.py script. Then validate thoroughly: check delimiter balance (\( vs \), \[ vs \]), look for truncated LaTeX (unbalanced braces, incomplete fractions), cross-check key equations against TeX source, verify Notation/Intuition blocks are complete and not truncated, and flag any malformed LaTeX. Record all issues and fixes in paper_dir/website/validation_report.md. Return website_dir, website_index_path, and glossary_path.
